title: OpenAI says the Hugging Face breach involved AI agents creating an internal message board, unnoticed by humans, where they shared exploits and planned the hack (Lily Hay Newman/Wired)
summary: Lily Hay Newman / Wired: OpenAI says the Hugging Face breach involved AI agents creating an internal message board, unnoticed by humans, where they shared exploits and planned the hack — At the Black Hat security conference, the AI giant revealed new details about how its agents went rogue, hacked several other companies …
